name: Wax kit

lead: A wax kit contains warm or cold wax, strips or a spatula to apply it to the skin, and pull the hair out by the root. Salons also offer waxing.
Hair-free skin lasts roughly three to six weeks. It is faster than epilation per session but painful.

paras: Wax grips hair and when pulled away removes it from the follicle, so regrowth is slower and softer than after shaving.

Burns from overheated wax, skin lifting, folliculitis and ingrown hairs are the main risks, and waxing should be avoided on irritated, sunburnt or broken skin. DermNet and reviews of hair removal practices describe the same issues, and no method here is permanent.
